From: Marissa Cole <marissa.cole@redwood.com>

Cc: Camila Reyes <camila.reyes@redwood.com>, Alex Martinez <alex.martinez@redwood.com>

Subject: Stakeholder map & MAP: next steps

Hi Samir / Emily —

Thanks again for the time today — really appreciate the candid overview of FinPay's goals around reducing per-transaction LLM cost while keeping 99th percentile latency under 120ms for customer-facing flows. Quick recap and proposed next steps so we’re aligned: 

Recap (from call):
- Primary goal: Cut inference unit cost ~30% while keeping perceived latency stable for end users.
- Decision criteria: latency/SLO, unit cost, security controls (no customer data stored outside VPC), and procurement timelines.
- POC scope: evaluate Redwood Dedicated (predictable throughput) + Private option for data isolation; test 2 high-volume prompts and embeddings pipeline.

Open items we discussed:
1) Stakeholder map — who will own procurement/contract, security review, and the economic decision?
2) Security questionnaire & evidence — your InfoSec reviewer contact and typical SLA/retention requirements.
3) Target timeline & milestones — POC start window and procurement lead time.

Proposed Mutual Action Plan (high level):
- Share stakeholder map (this email) — owner: FinPay; due: ASAP
- Security questionnaire submitted (Redwood delivers answers + evidence) — owner: Redwood (Camila) / FinPay (security) — target: 2 weeks
- Technical POC (3 weeks) — owner: FinPay + Redwood — target start: week of Apr 6 (flexible)
- Procurement & pricing alignment (SOW + pricing) — owner: Alex (Redwood) / Carla (FinPay) — target: concurrent with POC
- Contract signature / pilot go-live — target: end of May (TBD)

I attached a MAP template and our SLA overview. Can you confirm the stakeholder list below and whether the timeline needs shifting? If that works, I’ll schedule a 30-min working session next week to walk the MAP and hand off the security questionnaire.

Attachments: FinPay-MAP-v1.0.xlsx (MAP template), Redwood-SLA-Overview.pdf

Thanks —
Marissa Cole
Senior Account Executive | Redwood Inference
marissa.cole@redwood.com | (415) 555-0124

Marissa — thanks for the clear recap and proposed MAP. Quick answers on stakeholders:
- Economic buyer: Samir Shah (me) — will own final approval on spend.
- Procurement lead: Carla Gomez (carla.gomez@finpay.com) — will need SOW + pricing and our standard contracting terms.
- Security reviewer: Michael Tran (mtr@finpay.com) — InfoSec; will run the questionnaire and request any evidence (SOC2, retention controls, KMS).

Please share the questionnaire and we’ll get Michael and Carla looped into the working session.
